messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2.5.1 -> 20% US-WEST started (ts: 2146789012). Monitoring hooks enabled. p95 baseline comparison will stream to #eng-releases.

Maya (release-mgr): seeing p95 +12% vs baseline after ~6m. error-rate +0.6% (still under auto-rollback threshold). Not auto-tripping but looks correlated with the kernel-selection flag change. @olivia can you confirm logs?

Olivia (oncall): digging in. k-v cache hits look normal, but there are CPU microburst spikes on a subset of instances. stack traces point to the new kernel-selection path in runtime: `choose_kernel_fast()` — several GC short pauses line up with requests.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): that's the rollout we enabled to optimize long-context routing. Reverting just the kernel-selection toggle should be low-risk and quick. Command to flip in canary:
```
infra deploy toggle runtime.kernel_selection=false --env=canary --reason="p95-regression-2146789012"
```

Rachel (sre): agree with targeted toggle first. If that drops p95 back toward baseline in 10m, we can continue rollout paused, patch the kernel-selection logic, and then re-attempt. If it doesn't improve, escalate to full canary revert and pin.

Maya (release-mgr): plan: 1) flip kernel_selection=false in canary now, 2) hold any traffic increase, 3) monitor 10m window for p50/p95/error-rate/serving-threads, 4) if improved -> keep canary at 20% and start patch branch; if not -> execute canary rollback to v2.5.0 and notify customers. @tom prepare a short note for customers if we need extended maintenance.

Olivia (oncall): executing toggle now.

deploy-bot: Action received: `infra deploy toggle runtime.kernel_selection=false --env=canary` — rollout in progress.

Olivia (oncall): toggle returned OK on 10/10 instances. kicking off smoke suite: `ci smoke --suite=canary-basic --timeout=3m`

Rachel (sre): smoke passed on all smoke paths. starting 10m monitor window.

(10 minutes pass)

Olivia (oncall): update after 10m: p95 dropped to +3% vs baseline, error-rate back to +0.1%, CPU spikes disappeared in traces. Looks like the kernel-selection flag was the primary contributor.

Sanjay (eng-runtime): good signal. I'll open a PR with more conservative heuristics and a unit/regression test for the selection path. We should also add a canary-only telemetry flag to detect this earlier.

Maya (release-mgr): decision: no full rollback. Keep canary at 20% with kernel_selection=false. Hold further rollout until the PR lands and we validate. I'll update release notes + changelog with a note about the rollback of that optimization and planned rework.

Tom (product): I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb in case they noticed latency jitter. ping me if we decide to broaden impact or schedule a maintenance window.

Maya (release-mgr): action items: @Sanjay PR + test (ETA 4h), @Olivia confirm canary health every hour until roll resumed, @Rachel file a short incident log (severity: minor, cause: kernel-selection path regression). I'll update the release branch to pin runtime flag to false by default until fixed.

deploy-bot: Canary status: 20% US-WEST, kernel_selection=false, health: nominal. Notifying release channel subscribers.

Maya (release-mgr): thanks team. Postmortem after PR merge; short debrief at 3pm PT in #eng-releases. :white_check_mark:
